rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; f8949 p. 1, box G: "Short-term transactions reported on Form(s) 1099-DA showing basis was reported to the IRS"; i8949 p. 8, code B. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.json`, written by triage.py this round; 1,565 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 589 partial records from 40 bases; 2,145 comparisons): 2,136 agree; 7 value, 1 candidate-unknown, 1 project-unknown (none on a completed return). Same column (e) expression as the before-catalog-refresh ruling (bklg). The reply adds boxes G and J to the reported-basis boxes, the source's reading; Boxes G to L are refused for the return by sales.digital at sales.one (checked this round: sales.refuse.digital.G refuses Form 1040 lines 7a and 16 on sales[a].digital), so the 7 values cannot reach a completed return. The bklg model error (candidate-refuses on the reply's own h_basis_bad on completed returns) does not recur: no difference is on a completed return. BUG-0395's sales.correct_basis wording matches i8949 p. 6, Schedule A (Form 8971): "first use an amount that is equal to or less than the final estate tax value listed in Part II, column (h)". Project stands.

Ruling: representation and scope; i8949 p. 10, code W: "enter the amount of the nondeductible loss as a positive number in column (g)"; i8949 p. 8, code B. executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.json`, written by triage.py this round; 1,565 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 589 partial records from 40 bases; 2,145 comparisons): 1,984 agree; 139 candidate-unknown, 16 candidate-refuses, 6 project-unknown (none on a completed return). Same expressions as the before-catalog-refresh ruling (bklg, representation), which stands for the values: no value differs. The candidate-unknown and candidate-refuses witnesses are on incomplete or refused returns, where the reply reads the correct basis or its own code refusals that the project reaches through sales.bad_code (sales.refuse.code refuses Form 1040 line 7a) or sales.wash_bad (sales.refuse.wash_over_loss); the 6 project-unknown are partials withholding a sale's answers the interview asks of every sale. Boxes G to L are refused for the return by sales.digital at sales.one (checked this round: sales.refuse.digital.G refuses Form 1040 lines 7a and 16 on sales[a].digital). Project stands.
